name: Influencer Brief
description: Produces a completed creator/influencer brief with brand context, campaign goal, content guidance, deliverables, and dos/don'ts for influencer marketing partnerships. Use when the user asks to create an influencer brief, plan a creator collaboration, write guidelines for sponsored content, or structure an influencer marketing partnership. Do NOT use for PR media pitches (use pr-pitch), social media strategy (use social-media-strategy), or paid ad copy written in-house (use paid-ad-copy).
